Miqaat is a prayer clock. It calculates the five daily prayer times on this device for the place you choose, plays the azaan, and can count down to iqamah for prayer at home.  Nothing is uploaded: there is no account, no advertising and no analytics. Two things use the network — the optional place-name lookup (Android's geocoder, run by Google) and the update check on GitHub in the direct-download edition. Both are off until you use them.
